learning_outcomes.text: Ability to model using mathematical knowledge.
Ability to produce solutions to complex problems or problems difficult/impossible to solve analytically using simple arithmetic operations.
Ability to analyze the accuracy of methods.
Ability to develop and apply software programs for numerical solutions.

syllabus_topics: Functions of a Single Variable, Domain, Limit, Continuity, Derivative, Applications of Derivative, Integral, Sequences and Series, Applications of Taylor and Maclauren Series, Vectors.
IEEE Arithmetic and Sources of Computation Errors
Definitions: Bit, Byte, Word, Number Representation (decimal, binary and hexadecimal)
Sources of Errors Significant Figures, Accuracy and Precision, Error Definitions, Round-off Errors, Truncation Error.
Solutions of Non-linear Equations
Bracketing Methods: Graphical Methods, Bisection Method, False Position Method.
Open Methods: Simple Fixed-Point Iteration, Newton-Raphson Method, Secant Method.
System of Non-linear Equations
Solutions of Linear Equations
Elimination Methods: Gauss, Gauss-Jordan
LU Method, Matrix Inversion
Gauss-Seidel Method
Curve Fitting and Interpolation
Least Squares Methods: Linear Regression, Polynomial Regression, Non-linear Regression
Interpolation: Newton's Divided Difference Interpolation Polynomials, Lagrange Interpolation Polynomials
Numerical integration
Trapezoidal rule, Simpson's rules, Multiple segment Trapezoid and Simpson
Numerical Solutions of Ordinary Differential Equations
Single-Step Methods: Euler's Method, Heun's Method, 2nd Order Runge-Kutta Method, 4th Order Runge-Kutta Method.
Multi-Step Methods: Adams-Bashforth Method.
bibliography: Numerical Methods for Engineers, Steven C. Chapra, Raymond P. Canale, 7th Edition, McGraw-Hill. 2014.
Applied numerical methods with MATLAB for engineers and scientists, Steven C. Chapra, 3rd Edition, McGraw-Hill. 2011.
Numerical Analysis Using MATLAB® and Excel®, Third Edition, Steven T. Karris, Orchard Publications, 2007.
Calculus: A Complete Course, Robert Adams, Christopher Essex, 10th Edition, Toronto, Canada, 2010
